mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_messages ( conversation_id, user_id, role, content, response_type, proposal_id, idempotency_key, status ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{responseType}, #{proposalId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND message_id > #{afterMessageId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' ORDER BY message_id ASC LIMIT 1
